recreation_brief:
1. Set the slide background to solid light gray (#f0f0f0); use a blank layout with no placeholders.
2. Draw a rectangle with no fill and a thin red (#c00000) outline positioned just inside all four slide edges to frame the content area.
3. Draw a solid black (#000000) rectangle spanning the full slide width as a thin strip along the very bottom edge.
4. In the top-right corner, draw a small circle approx 5% x 5% of slide size, inset about 5% from the top and right edges, with white (#ffffff) fill and a thin purple (#800080) outline; center the numeral '1' inside it in purple (#800080).
5. In the title area (top + center, approx 25% of slide height), insert a text box with the exact text 'Introduction to Artificial Neural Networks (ANN)' — large, bold, sans-serif, red (#c00000), horizontally centered, sentence case exactly as written.
6. Directly below the title and horizontally centered, insert the text 'CSAI 253 - Spring 2024' in medium-weight blue (#000080) sans-serif.
7. In the vertical middle of the slide, centered horizontally as a block, build the 'Prepared By' block as three stacked lines: line 1 'Prepared By' in bold red (#c00000); line 2 'Dr. Khaled Mostafa ElSayed' in blue (#000080); line 3 'kmelsayed@zewailcity.edu.eg' in smaller blue (#000080).
8. In the bottom-left area, build the instructors list: header line 'Instructors:' in bold red (#c00000), then four left-aligned blue (#000080) lines in this order — 'Dr. Khaled Mostafa ElSayed', 'kmelsayed@zewailcity.edu.eg' (smaller), 'Dr. Mohamed Maher Ata', 'momaher@zewailcity.edu.eg' (smaller).
9. In the bottom-right corner, place the university logo box: left panel teal (#008080) containing a white mountain/wave icon with the wordmark 'ZEWAL CITY' and tiny text 'ZEWAL CITY OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY'; right panel white (#ffffff) with the Arabic line 'جامعة العلوم والتكنولوجيا زويل' above the English line 'University of Science and Technology' in black (#000000); the logo palette also includes a red (#c00000) accent. If the official logo asset is unavailable, rebuild it as this two-panel rectangle.
10. Apply alignment: title (step 5) and course code (step 6) centered on the slide; 'Prepared By' block (step 7) centered as a block; instructors list (step 8) left-aligned; all text sans-serif, no italics anywhere.
11. Final check: slide is fully static (no animations or transitions); verify all eight elements — red border, black bottom bar, number circle, title, course code, prepared-by block, instructors list, logo — are present and colors match the hex codes above.
